name: MonarchText
title: Heading
summary: A heading is MonarchText in one of the heading roles (Display, Title, Heading, Subheading), which TalkBack announces as a heading. Monarch ships no separate heading type.
whenToUse: For the title of a screen, a section or a card. Choose the role by how large the heading should look; for a small heading in BodyStrong or Label pass heading = true.
whenNotToUse: For the title of a top app bar use the Material 3 TopAppBar title slot, which is already a heading for TalkBack. For running text use MonarchText in the Body role.
api: @Composable fun MonarchText(text: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, style: MonarchTextStyle = MonarchTextStyle.Body, color: Color = Color.Unspecified, textAlign: TextAlign? = null, overflow: TextOverflow = TextOverflow.Clip, softWrap: Boolean = true, maxLines: Int = Int.MAX_VALUE, minLines: Int = 1, heading: Boolean = style.isHeading)

options.name: style
options.description: The look. Display is the web size 4xl, Title 2xl, Heading xl, Subheading lg, BodyStrong base and Label sm.

options.name: heading
options.default: true for Display, Title, Heading, Subheading
options.description: Whether TalkBack announces the text as a heading. Pass true for a heading in BodyStrong or Label, false for a large text that is not a heading.

options.name: color
options.description: MonarchTheme.colors.textMuted for a secondary heading, such as the title of an empty section.

options.name: maxLines
options.description: 1 with overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis keeps the heading to one line.

options.name: overflow
options.description: Ellipsis ends a cut heading with an ellipsis.

states.name: one line
states.description: maxLines = 1 and overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis keep the heading to one line and end it with an ellipsis.

appearance: The heading roles use the default text color in semibold (Display in bold) with tight or snug line height and letter spacing, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web Heading sets the outline level (h1 to h6) and the visual size separately. Compose has no heading levels: Modifier.semantics { heading() } marks a heading, and TalkBack moves between headings without a level, so the web's level is not offered (iOS adds a level with accessibilityHeading). The web sizes 3xl and 5xl have no role; Display (4xl) is the nearest. The web weight option is not offered: the role decides the weight. Tone and truncation are the color, maxLines and overflow parameters of MonarchText.
accessibility: Display, Title, Heading and Subheading set the heading semantics property, so TalkBack users can move between headings.
heading = true makes a BodyStrong or Label text a heading; heading = false removes it from a large text.
Every role is in sp and grows with the font size setting.
A heading wraps by default, so no text is lost at large sizes; a one-line heading still gives TalkBack its whole text.
edgeCases: A heading role used for a large number or a price is still announced as a heading; pass heading = false.
With maxLines = 1 and an ellipsis the cut-off part is still read by TalkBack, because the text is the whole string.
Text balancing (the web text-wrap: balance) is not available in Compose.

examples.title: Levels and their default sizes
A small, muted heading on one line
examples.code:
MonarchText(
    text = "Nothing here yet",
    style = MonarchTextStyle.BodyStrong,
    color = MonarchTheme.colors.textMuted,
    maxLines = 1,
    overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
    heading = true,
)

parityExceptions.reason: Android semantics have one heading flag and no outline levels (h1 to h4); the type style carries the visual size.
parityExceptions.convention: Android accessibility: SemanticsPropertyReceiver.heading() marks a heading; TalkBack has no heading levels.
